keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Lucas Soares (Santa Clara) is shown the yellow card.
Delay in match because of an injury David Moreira (Gil Vicente).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Diogo Prioste (Gil Vicente) is shown the yellow card.
Own Goal by Antonio Espigares, Gil Vicente. Santa Clara 1, Gil Vicente 0.
Fernando (Santa Clara) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
First Half ends, Santa Clara 1, Gil Vicente 0.
Goal! Santa Clara 1, Gil Vicente 1. Walace França (Gil Vicente) header from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Murilo with a cross following a corner.
Emanuel Moreira (Santa Clara) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Pedro Pacheco (Santa Clara) is shown the red card.
Substitution, Santa Clara. Henrique Silva replaces João Vasconcelos.
Substitution, Gil Vicente. Zé Carlos replaces Diogo Prioste.
Kamika (Santa Clara) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Santa Clara 1, Gil Vicente 2. Murilo (Gil Vicente) from a free kick with a left footed shot to the bottom right corner.
Substitution, Santa Clara. Gonçalo Paciência replaces Fernando.
Substitution, Santa Clara. Vitinho replaces Djé Tavares.
Substitution, Santa Clara. Sorriso replaces Vinícius Lopes.
Substitution, Gil Vicente. Mohamed Kaba replaces Walace França.
Substitution, Gil Vicente. Guilherme Gomes replaces Andreas Lausen.
Mohamed Kaba (Gil Vicente) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Santa Clara. Léo Jacó replaces Kamika.
Substitution, Gil Vicente. Agustín Moreira replaces Murilo.
